plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: Public at https://openvibe.wiki since 2026-09-23 (~03:00 UTC): deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy wiki`, /opt/openvibe.wiki, unit openvibe-wiki on 127.0.0.1:4800 behind the openvibe.wiki nginx vhost, principal wiki. On 2026-09-23 production held 1 space and the 10 seed pages (1 revision each), 0 person reviews, so every page was noindex and nothing public was in Search. Restore drill passed 2026-09-23.
seed: official space "openvibe" (10 pages summarised with AI assistance from the repositories' README/STATUS files, cited; noindex until a person reviews each; 0 of 10 reviewed as of 2026-09-23)
features: spaces with page trees and roles
immutable revisions with diff, revert and scheduled publication
citations and infobox values bound to the revision that used them
public, signed-in, VIP (OpenVibe.VIP), private and members-only visibility
Media attachments with a broken-asset state
AI proposals that need a person's approval
feeds, sitemaps and server-rendered pages useful without JavaScript
SDK outbox events and Search index documents
